title: Concept: Composer accepts cleartext package downloads
description: composer.json declares `secure-http` turned off, which permits http downloads, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Any repository URL can be served over cleartext, so a network attacker can replace the archive and its metadata.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: Any repository URL can be served over cleartext, so a network attacker can replace the archive and its metadata.
